source.surface: app.outlier.bet game page, Player props tab, Passing market group
source.account: Runner Sports business profile, owner-authenticated browser session
source.capture_method: Manual browser observation of one game view. Two accordion rows expanded by hand and read as rendered. No credential handling, no access-control bypass, no crawl beyond this single view.

authority.note: Third-party research product observation. Not a licensed feed, not an executable quote, not a Runner model output. No Outlier projection, rating, edge, grade or recommendation is recorded here.

headline_finding.statement: Chicago's quarterback passing-prop market is priced for Case Keenum (#11) and Tyson Bagent (#17). No Caleb Williams passing market is offered on this page.
headline_finding.confidence: HIGH for what the board offers; the accessible names and jersey numbers were read directly from the rendered market list.
headline_finding.inference: Market composition implies Keenum is the expected Chicago starter and Bagent the backup: Keenum carries the full market set (Yards, TDs, Attempts, Completions, Completion %, Longest Completion, Pass+Rush, Interceptions, Sacks Taken) while Bagent carries only Yards, TDs and Pass+Rush.
headline_finding.verification_required: This is market evidence, not an official source. Confirm against the official NFL injury report, the team's inactives list or a club release before recording a Chicago starter anywhere in Runner. Do not publish a player-availability claim on market composition alone.
headline_finding.explains: This is the most likely driver of the open-to-consensus move recorded in bettingpros-phi-chi-2026-09-28.json: five points of spread toward Philadelphia and a four-point decline in the total. That artifact's movement block is marked UNEXPLAINED and should stay so until the official confirmation above is obtained.

alternate_line_ladders.method_note: Outlier presents each prop as an expandable alternate-line ladder. Ladders below were read from the rendered rows of the expanded accordion.

Tyson Bagent - Passing Yards.reason: Row left collapsed; not expanded in this pass.

alternate_line_ladders.parse_caveat: Per-rung prices were recovered from rendered row text, and two independent parses of the Keenum ladder disagreed on price-to-side alignment at the margin (pivot read as 170.5 under one and 172.5 under the other). The line ranges, rung counts and approximate main lines are reliable; individual rung prices are NOT, and must be re-read directly from the screen before any calculation uses them.

quality_flags.note: P(over) should be non-increasing as the threshold rises. Violations were counted after de-vigging each rung proportionally. Because of the parse caveat above, these are candidate anomalies, not confirmed stale or crossed rungs. Re-verify on screen before treating any of them as an inefficiency.
quality_flags.hold_dispersion: Pivot-rung hold differs sharply between players (about 2 percent for Keenum, about 8 percent for Hurts). Any EV work across these ladders must use each rung's own two-sided price, never one assumed margin.

coverage.not_captured_reason: Out of scope for this pass. Sweeping every market group would be repeated extraction, which the source rights do not permit without a written agreement.

next_actions: Confirm the Chicago starting quarterback against the official injury report or inactives list, then update the movement interpretation in bettingpros-phi-chi-2026-09-28.json.

Re-read the Keenum and Hurts pivot rungs directly on screen if any ladder price is to be used numerically.
